d: Chayan Rastogi brings you a fun, unfiltered and absolutely ODD conversation with actor Suhail Nayyar, who recently impressed audiences in Udta Teer and is all set to be seen as Sugriv in Nitesh Tiwari's much-awaited Ramayana: Rise of a Legend, starring Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram and Yash as Ravana. From playing a Pakistani agent in Udta Teer to becoming Vanar Raj Sugriv in Ramayana, how did this unexpected transformation happen? We discuss his casting, working with Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, prosthetics, life on the sets of Ramayana and what audiences can expect from this massive cinematic…
